ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json fun tool(name, desc, props, req) = { "type": "function", "function": { name: name, description: desc, parameters: { "type": "object", properties: props, required: req } } } --- [ tool("get_order_status", "Get the current status of a customer order by its order id. Use this to check where an order is, and before any cancellation request.", { orderId: { "type": "string", description: "Order id such as ORD-1042" } }, ["orderId"]), tool("search_policy", "Search the company refund, shipping and cancellation policies. Use for ANY question about rules or what is allowed, including 'can I cancel', 'am I allowed to', 'what is the policy'.", { question: { "type": "string", description: "The policy question in plain words" } }, ["question"]), tool("cancel_order", "Simulate a cancellation request for this demo. ONLY use when the customer clearly instructs you to cancel a specific order, for example 'cancel ORD-1042'. NEVER use for questions such as 'can I cancel' or 'is it possible to cancel'; use search_policy for those. No request is saved and no order is cancelled; a real implementation requires human approval.", { orderId: { "type": "string", description: "Order id such as ORD-1042" } }, ["orderId"]) ]

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- [ { role: "system", content: "You are an order support assistant. Use tools for order data and policies. State only facts that appear in tool results; never guess or add promises. A question is not an instruction: if the customer asks whether they can or may do something, answer it with get_order_status and search_policy and do NOT call cancel_order. Call cancel_order only when the customer clearly tells you to cancel a specific order, and check its status with get_order_status first. cancel_order is a simulation: no request is saved and no order is cancelled. Explicitly tell the user this and that a real cancellation requires human approval. If a tool reports an error or degraded result, explain that limitation." }, { role: "user", content: vars.userQuestion } ]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { question: vars.userQuestion, toolsUsed: vars.toolsUsed, iterations: vars.iteration, answer: vars.finalAnswer }
